Legal • Data Governance

Privacy Policy

At MOYA Academy (Mechanism of YouTube Automation), we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency in how your data is collected, used, and safeguarded. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you access our platform, curriculum, services, and advisory channels. By accessing or using MOYA, you agree to the practices outlined in this policy.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information necessary to deliver educational curriculums, event tickets, and strategic YouTube automation advisory:

Personal Information

When you register for a masterclass, enroll in a curriculum, or request advisory access, we may collect:

  • Full Name
  • Email Address
  • WhatsApp / Phone Number
  • Billing & Transaction Reference Details

Usage & Telemetry Data

We collect technical data regarding platform interactions to maintain high performance:

  • Browser type and device specifications
  • Page navigation flow, timestamps, and referral parameters
  • Session duration and feature engagement metrics

Cookies & Local Storage

We utilize lightweight session mechanisms to:

  • Preserve intent selection during enquiry workflows
  • Measure aggregate site traffic performance without invasive profiling

2. How We Use Your Information

Information gathered is utilized solely for legitimate operational and service delivery purposes:

  • To provide, operate, and refine our training programs and channel blueprints
  • To manage masterclass access, bootcamp schedules, and enrollment onboarding
  • To dispatch transactional receipts, calendar reminders, and urgent curriculum updates
  • To maintain secure direct communication via WhatsApp and Email
  • To comply with statutory legal and regulatory obligations

3. Data Protection & Security Architecture

We employ robust administrative and technical controls to safeguard your personal information:

  • TLS 1.3 / SSL encryption across all data transmissions
  • Strict least-privilege administrative access controls
  • Tokenized payment gateway processing where financial credentials never touch our web servers

While we apply rigorous security protocols, no digital transmission over the internet can be guaranteed as entirely immune from compromise.

4. Third-Party Disclosures

We never sell, rent, or trade your personal data to commercial data brokers. Data is shared exclusively with verified operational partners:

  • Authorized payment gateways (Razorpay / Stripe)
  • CRM & scheduling automation systems (GoHighLevel)
  • Web infrastructure and analytics providers

These partners are bound by confidentiality obligations and permitted to process data solely to execute requested services.

5. User Rights & Data Control

You maintain full control over your personal data, including the right to:

  • Request access to stored personal records
  • Request correction or updating of outdated details
  • Request permanent deletion of your profile from active communication channels
  • Opt out of broadcast notifications at any time

To exercise any data rights, submit your request directly to: cashytautomation@gmail.com

6. External Platforms

Our curriculum covers third-party platforms including YouTube, Google, and video automation tooling. We do not control and are not responsible for the privacy practices or platform terms of third-party platforms.

7. Revisions to This Policy

We reserve the right to amend this Privacy Policy as regulatory or operational requirements evolve. Updates take effect immediately upon publication on this page.
